# currency-cents

> Money as integer cents: parsing, formatting, arithmetic, and fair allocation without rounding loss.

Work with money using integers (cents) to avoid float errors. Parse decimals, add/subtract/multiply, allocate fairly without losing pennies, format to strings. For invoices and payments.

## API

- `fromDecimal(str)` → number
- `format(cents, opts?)` → string
- `add(a, b)`, `subtract(a, b)`, `multiply(cents, scalar)`, `applyPercent(cents, percent)`
- `allocate(total, ratios)` → number[]

## Install

```bash
npm install currency-cents
```

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/Ruzylo-cloud/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
